title: Concept: Credential stored in IndexedDB
description: An IndexedDB open call followed by a credential field name in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: IndexedDB is readable by any script on the origin and persists across sessions, so a token or password stored there survives the tab and is available to an injected script.
applicability: Offline-first apps, mobile web shells and client caches.
risk: Stored credentials give any injected script a durable session, not just the current page.
